raw_text: A new operator, claim_check, was built to adjudicate the claimed-versus-actual discrepancies produced by the right_pass against a NAMED external baseline — a comparison that no existing channel in the pipeline performed. The operator is deliberately constrained: it is report-only, never writes to the store, and never feeds confirmed tension back into the system. It uses repeated draws with modal voting to decide a verdict, and any verdict falling outside the sanctioned enum is coerced to "unverifiable" rather than allowed to become a guess. The team recognized this must be defense in depth — the enum invariant is enforced inside check_claim, the function that actually decides the reported verdict, not only in the lower adjudicate_once layer where the guard originally sat.
